text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of the "Summer Training Camp."
Intensive training begins to level up our abilities!
Or so it should have been, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Watermelon splitting, flowing somen,
and a summer veggie barbecue party☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Summer's full of fun, buono things~.
choice_data_list: ...You do realize we came here to train, right?
...You do realize we came here to train, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I know~
The Sprinters Stakes is waiting for us, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Training comes first, after all.
I'll do my very best~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Buono-cha~n!
They said we're allowed to do watermelon splitting on the beach~☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And also, Biko-chan said
she was able to borrow a wooden sword~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you~! I brought
a ton of super sweet watermelon too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You see, this is something
we've all been planning together for a while now~.

"I promise I'll do my best in training too!
Making that promise, Hishi Akebono dashed off to the beach
where her friends were waiting."

All in all... the passionate summer training camp
with Hishi Akebono has started!
